anchors.evidence: The blue route passes along Obrucheva between the two Stasova carriageways. The terminal is at the northern endpoint of OSM way 1256904804, beside the sourced Raduzhny platform. A pre-stop A-to-B stub and a post-stop B-to-A connector created two spurious immediate reversals; neither belongs to the driven itinerary.
